mathematical_meanings: Left image: x denotes the unknown length of the vertical leg. Right image: x denotes the unknown length of the hypotenuse.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at x beside the left vertical leg; the right occurrence is at x beside the sloping hypotenuse. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-length variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
